name: skylight_gen
describe: Per-column initial skylight map: from a column's top-down block opacities + per-segment non-null storage mask + topFilledSegment + hasSkyLight, produce the heightMap value and the per-cell skylight nibbles (15-attenuation ladder). Golden captured live via NetheriteMod 'capture_skylight' (skylight zeroed then real generateSkylightMap run, read back).
